title: The Powerhouse CLI (ph-cmd) provides all essential commands for project lifecycle management
content:
The Powerhouse CLI (`ph-cmd`) is the primary tool for managing Powerhouse projects. Key commands:

- `ph init` - Initialize a new project (scaffolds directory structure from boilerplate)
- `ph vetra --watch` - Launch Vetra Studio with live code generation (recommended)
- `ph vetra --interactive` - Launch with confirmation prompts before generation
- `ph connect` - Run Connect locally. It is a subcommand group over `studio`, `build`, `preview`, and `config`, defaulting to `studio`; `ph connect build` is the mandatory production build step
- `ph generate` - Generate code. This is a **subcommand group**, not a flag-driven command; its subcommands are `all`, `document-model`, `editor`, `app`, `processor`, `subgraph`, `migration-file`
  - `ph generate document-model --document <file>` - Generate code from an exported specification
  - `ph generate editor --name <str> --document-type <str>` - Generate an editor template (the option is singular: `--document-type`)
  - `ph generate app --name <str> --document-types <value>` - Generate a drive app; this replaced the old `--drive-editor`
  - `ph generate subgraph --name <str>` and `ph generate processor --name <str> --type <str> --document-types <str>`
- `ph reactor` / `ph switchboard` - Start the API service (`reactor` is an alias of `switchboard`)
- `ph install <package>` / `ph uninstall <package>` - Manage published Powerhouse packages
- `ph publish` - Publish the project to a registry
- `ph login` - Create/link a Renown identity; `ph access-token` - mint a bearer token from that identity
- `ph list` - List installed Powerhouse packages; `ph inspect <package>` - show a package's structure and config
- `ph migrate` - Run migrations to a newer Powerhouse version
- `ph use <tag>` - Switch dependency release tag; `ph use-local <path>` - point dependencies at a local monorepo checkout
- `ph update` - Update dependencies to latest versions

The CLI supports four release tags: `latest` (stable), `staging`, `dev`, and `rc`. There is no `prod` tag, and `local` is not a tag either -- local monorepo dependencies are handled by the separate `ph use-local` command.

_Corrected 2026-08-13 against Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45._
description: Install globally via `pnpm install -g ph-cmd`. Key commands: ph init, ph vetra, ph connect, ph generate, ph reactor.
